//: The kinds of people the bundled town's settlement asks for, by role (10 §11.2): each a `person` (or a `dog`) thinking by a mind of its own. The settlement's data names them in its zones and sites; what they do all day is their minds' routines.
name: Shopkeeper

//: A house dog made in the world takes the nearest person to it for its master, as it is made and as it comes back into the world: it holds `core:loyal` toward them, and `follow_owner` keeps it near them.
doc: Makes a house dog loyal to the nearest person within twelve metres of where it is made.
Makes a house dog that comes back into the world loyal to the nearest person within twelve metres.
